description: Set up a Proof-of-Stake validator node on Ethereum (post-Merge) for an institutional staking operation. The setup must follow: establish key custody (generate validator signing keys using EIP-2333, store in a hardware security module or distributed key generation), configure the signing client (Prysm/Lighthouse/TEKU beacon node + validator client), register the validator (submit the deposit transaction of 32 ETH to the deposit contract via the validator deposit CLI), set up monitoring (alerting on missed attestations, low balance, slashing warnings), and establish an exit/stop plan (voluntary exit via beacon chain exit message, key rotation procedure). A rollback plan must exist (voluntary exit before slashing, but note: deposited ETH cannot be withdrawn until after the exit and withdrawal queue processes). Risk factors: key compromise leads to slashing (permanent ETH loss), validator downtime leads to inactivity leaks, and the deposit is partially irreversible (withdrawal requires the exit queue). Tools available: Prysm/Lighthouse/TEKU, staking-deposit-cli (EIP-2333), Prometheus, Grafana, hardware HSM (YubiHSM/Ledger).
